content_fields.title: Change insecure configuration defaults and remove unnecessary features
content_fields.description: Change insecure database defaults and remove features the application does not use.
content_fields.guidance: The server should be brought to a hardened baseline: default accounts removed, sample databases dropped, unused extensions and procedural languages disabled, and listen addresses narrowed.
content_fields.found: The stock PostgreSQL image runs with default settings, a default superuser named `admin` and a fixed password from the compose file.
content_fields.missing: A hardened server configuration and the baseline that defines it.
content_fields.conclusion: Server hardening is applied to the database instance, not through application source.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should apply the hardening baseline to the instance.
